subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers require real Control UI browser/gateway proof for this watchdog branch, waive the proof gate, or pause this replacement PR?
rationale: Automation cannot safely prove the contributor/bot replacement's live browser and gateway behavior from unit tests alone, and the branch also needs human handling for dirty merge state and exact-head CI failures.

options.title: Prove and refresh the watchdog path
options.body: Capture redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof for missed-terminal recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush, then refresh the branch until the merge result and checks are reviewable.

options.title: Waive proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can apply a proof override if they are comfortable landing timer-driven chat recovery based on source review and tests without live UI proof.

options.title: Pause or close this replacement
options.body: If the proof effort or conflict refresh is not worth pursuing, close or pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open for another current-main recovery approach.

recommendation.title: Prove and refresh the watchdog path
recommendation.body: Capture redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof for missed-terminal recovery, history reload, and queued follow-up flush, then refresh the branch until the merge result and checks are reviewable.

likelyOwner.reason: The proof decision spans the Control UI chat path and the gateway `agent.wait` contract, where this history pass found adjacent ownership signals.
